note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The context is the desk after the two cards were aligned; a lens opens a real enlarged copy of the focus card's upper part (badge, role, title, reference tag) and substitutes ONE supplied datum — the reference tag (beforeValue → afterValue; an empty beforeValue means the reference supplied in decisions). The old value stays traceable in a 'was' band; the printed results are never touched; the changed-datum marker is the neutral Δ. No validity, responsibility or outcome is inferred. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry and contextLabels are editable.
